status.label: Clear Advanced Paste workflow candidate
status.detail: The request describes selection, correction, paste-back, no-popup feedback, and a single-trigger workflow.

next_action.label: Design in-place Quick Fix
next_action.reason: The desired interaction and clipboard-preservation goal are specific enough for product and technical design.

actions.label: Design Advanced Paste Quick Fix
actions.note: Define selection capture, AI transformation, replacement, busy/error feedback, clipboard preservation, and configurable activation. This drafts no upstream mutation.

judgment.rationale: The feature request specifies the complete user-visible workflow while leaving implementation choices for a focused design pass.
evidence: The requested action should select text, correct spelling and grammar, and paste the result back with one trigger.
If no text is selected, the proposal asks to operate on the complete editable text.
The desired UI is a busy indicator rather than a window or popup, and the workflow should avoid adding intermediate text to clipboard history.
judgment.recommended_action: Design an in-place Advanced Paste transformation flow with explicit selection, clipboard, error, and activation semantics.
